_comment: Template for mcp_apps/willow-bot/manifest.json — the steward as its own
principal (sealed 163b9a70, dispatch 4326FDFE; reworked D7BD9FE2 per
Loki's audit 207B3590, which re-derived the steward's real call list
from the live tick.py/heartbeat.py/deposits.py — 13 distinct tools
across 17 call sites — after the first cut's list was wrong). Not
consumed by any code path directly (F3, Loki 207B3590): this file is
the reference copy an operator/auditor reads to see what a sealed pair
should say; the actual write goes through either manifest.create (a
NEW seat — trust_owner_verbs.py on worktrees/feat-trust-owner-verbs,
read-only cited here, sha e77caf58ebff156f8b96daf38532e78a8e1e8299,
grammar below) or manifest_grant_request (WIDENING an existing seat's
groups — manifest_grant_executor.py).
Groups, and why each is here (none is full_access, none is orchestrator,
grove_relay is never granted):
steward_sweep       — seal_drain, net_authority_drain,
envelope_retire_sweep, gitsync_sweep (gate.py).
Tick-time maintenance that mirrors a human's own
prior seal or action; mints no new authority.
git_pull_execute was here in the first cut; Loki
F2 found no willow-bot call site for it
(gitsync_sweep reaches pull_executor directly,
server-side) — dropped.
steward_read        — human_required_list, fleet_health,
commitment_surface (heartbeat.py:28-30). Every
read the tick makes.
steward_human_loop   — human_required_enqueue AND human_required_resolve
(never human_attestation_create). Loki F1b: the
steward resolves the CI-red items it filed once
the head goes green / is superseded / the PR
closes (tick.py: _remember, run_ci_legacy_clear,
_backfill_stuck_items) — the first cut's
enqueue-only group left those calls EPERM and
every CI-red item open forever.
steward_store_write  — store_put, store_delete ONLY (never
store_update/store_purge_collection/
agent_seed_mirror — the general store_write
group's other members). Confined to exactly
willow_bot_ci_deposits and idea_landings by
store_scope/store_write below, not by this
group (Loki F1c).
steward_gap_resolve  — gap_resolve only (tick.py:2932, run_resolve).
steward_dispatch     — dispatch_send. OPEN POLICY QUESTION, not
settled by this template — see gate.py's
steward_dispatch comment and 'THE QUESTION FOR
THE DESK' below before granting this seat this
group.
grove_read          — the 13 Grove read tools (channel/message/thread/
flag/bus/agent listing).
grove_write         — the 7 Grove write tools, GRANTED SEPARATELY by
pair f46474ee, not baked into this template —
the steward joins receive_dispatch's
grove_read+grove_write grant as the seventh
seat. Listed here so the shape is complete once
that pair lands; the group name alone carries
no authority until a signed manifest holds it.
Deliberately absent: full_access, orchestrator, grove_relay — a message
a human reads on #willow from the steward says willow-bot, never a
relayed identity.
THE QUESTION FOR THE DESK (Loki F4, dispatch D7BD9FE2): dispatch_send IS
a verb the steward ticks today (run_audit -> loki, tick.py:295/311) —
sealed 163b9a70 covers it on a plain reading, so 'no dispatch' in the
first cut was this builder's own policy, not the seal's. Two paths, and
this template does not pick one: (a) seal steward_dispatch as granted,
accepting it is UNBOUNDED beyond 'may call dispatch_send at all' —
gate.permitted() has no argument-level bounds, so 'to_app in {loki},
role=auditor' is not mechanically enforced; or (b) change run_audit to
human_required_enqueue(kind='dispatch', ...) instead and never grant
steward_dispatch. Until the desk seals one, steward_audit is dark on
any willow-bot checkout that has flipped identity without this decided
(Loki F5 merge order).
Fixture text — TWO grammars, for two different verbs:
manifest.create (NEW seat; trust_owner_verbs._CREATE_RE,
'^create seat (?P<app_id>[A-Za-z0-9_-]+) store_scope \\[(?P<store_scope>[^\\]]*)\\] store_write \\[(?P<store_write>[^\\]]*)\\] permissions \\[(?P<permissions>[^\\]]*)\\]$'):

create seat willow-bot store_scope [willow_bot_ci_deposits, idea_landings] store_write [willow_bot_ci_deposits, idea_landings] permissions [steward_sweep, steward_read, steward_human_loop, steward_store_write, steward_gap_resolve, grove_read, grove_write]
(steward_dispatch is deliberately OMITTED from this create line pending the desk's answer above; add it as a separate widening once sealed.)
manifest_grant_request (WIDENING an existing willow-bot manifest;
manifest_grant_executor's grammar, 'willow-manifest-grant-v1
seats=<a,b> groups=<c,d>'):
willow-manifest-grant-v1 seats=willow-bot groups=steward_sweep,steward_read,steward_human_loop,steward_store_write,steward_gap_resolve,grove_read,grove_write
(a LATER, separate sealed pair for steward_dispatch alone once the desk answers, e.g.:
willow-manifest-grant-v1 seats=willow-bot groups=steward_dispatch)
